high_level_description: This image depicts a serene and cozy rooftop garden scene. The setting appears to be a small, enclosed outdoor space with a wooden pergola providing shade. The walls of the structure are white, and there is a metal mesh fence at the back, which offers a view of buildings across the street. The rooftop is adorned with various potted plants of different sizes and types, creating a lush green environment. Some plants are placed on the ground, while others are hanging from the pergola.
